Targ. Prov. XIII, 21 (ed. Wil. Pa.); a. fr.—Part. רָדִיף.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 16:20">Targ. Deut. XVI, 20</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <he>תרדוף</he>).
Targ. Koh. III, 15; a. e.—Part. pass. רְדִיף quick, rapid.
<cite ref="Yoma 77b:14">Yoma 77ᵇ</cite> <he>שאני נחל דרְדִיפֵי מיא</he> it is different with a brook, because its waters are rapid.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:7">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>לאו משום … דרדיפי מיא</he> (not <he>דרדפי</he>) not because the water is very deep, but because it is so rapid; a. e.
